findings.title: Reno nurses to protest the abrupt closure of oncology unit
findings.publisher: National Nurses Organizing Committee / National Nurses United
findings.exact_supporting_passage: oncology charge nurses have been called off since October 26, and cancer patients are now on the medical-surgical floor.
findings.access_consequences: Union representing bedside nurses reports that Saint Mary's Regional Medical Center stopped staffing its dedicated oncology unit and moved patients to a medical-surgical floor. This is a loss of a specialized inpatient unit, not proof of hospital-wide oncology treatment cessation. Hospital management has not publicly confirmed the closure in the source.
findings.affected_population: Cancer inpatients at Saint Mary's Regional Medical Center; number affected not provided.
findings.source_role: First-party report from nursing union representing hospital staff; facility confirmation not located in bounded check.
